description: Northern Province - Northern Province Pre-School Education Statute No. 3 of 2015
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a new provincial statute (the Northern Province Pre-School Education Statute No. 03 of 2015) that establishes a legal framework for the registration, regulation, supervision, and monitoring of pre-schools in the Northern Province. It creates new legal requirements, establishes administrative structures (Pre-School Education Unit), and outlines regulatory powers and procedures. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which includes "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While it mentions government structures and positions, these are created by the statute itself rather than representing standalone government personnel or organizational changes.
